desc:
🚀 Steal and ride over 70 mechs, starfighters, hypercars and more!
🔥 OG LAUNCH: play now to claim OG cars before they're gone!

How to Play:
📦 Steal Mystery Crates from giant guardians
🏁 Race past the safe line to keep your crate
🎁 Unbox crates to collect rare rides
💰 Earn cash from the rides in your garage
⬆️ Upgrade your garage and Sim Rig
⚡ Train in the Sim Rig to gain Speed and reach new zones
💥 Knock crates off other players and steal them
👑 Battle giant bosses with your server
✨ Discover rarer crates, rides, paints and Auras!

🎮 Supports Mobile, Console, and PC Players
